description: Canonical NodeId derivation from an Ed25519 public key using BLAKE3-256 and lowercase unpadded RFC 4648 base32 encoding.

invariants.deterministic: The same Ed25519PublicKey MUST always produce the same NodeIdText.
invariants.binding: verifyNodeIdBinding(nodeIdText, publicKey) MUST return true iff nodeIdText == deriveNodeId(publicKey).
invariants.format: isValidNodeIdFormat(nodeIdText) MUST return true iff nodeIdText is exactly 52 lowercase base32 chars [a-z2-7] with canonical (zero) trailing bits.
invariants.noDualParsing: Implementations MUST NOT accept the retired 'node:' + hex scheme. There is no fallback derivation and no silent migration.

retiredScheme.description: The interim BLAKE2b-256 + 'node:' + lowercase-hex scheme is RETIRED.
retiredScheme.retiredReason: Build orchestrator selected BLAKE2b without Principal-Architect authority. The canonical scheme (BLAKE3 + base32) was approved 2026-08-16.
retiredScheme.noCompatibility: Implementations MUST NOT parse, accept, or derive the retired scheme. NodeIds produced under the retired scheme are not valid in the canonical scheme.

computedBy: reference/identity/keys.ts (BLAKE3 from @noble/hashes v2.3.0, base32 encoder in reference/identity/keys.ts)
verification: reference/identity/golden-vectors.ts runIdentityGoldenVectors() asserts all 8 sub-vectors at module load and on every test run.
notes: This vector contains ONLY the Ed25519 public key and expected NodeId. It does NOT contain any secret key, seed, or private material. The public key was derived from a fixed test seed for reproducibility, but the seed itself is not included here — conformance vectors must not carry private key material.
